name: Call of Elyndra
detailed_description:
Fight, Farm, Discover!

Embark on a hero's journey in Call of Elyndra, a hybrid cozy RPG adventure featuring retro pixel art and an engaging cast of characters. A prophetic dream beckons you to the vast world of Elyndra, where a ruthless Empire threatens many communities you'll defend. Uncover the truth and unravel the fate of this fantasy world by connecting with companions, fostering the local agriculture, and completing quests. You decide how you experience the world of Elyndra and save it from its evil foes!

You Decide

Are you ready to traverse this foreign land and face off against its hidden adversaries? Or would you prefer to support your community through farming crops and raising livestock? As Elyndra’s hero, you decide your playstyle. You can even do both!

A Driven Narrative

Call of Elyndra's expansive story centers on your completely unprepared hero as the prophesied one. Establish trust among your community by completing side quests around the village, using hints from the locals to discover the truth of the world around you.

Enjoy Farm Life

Don't feel like fighting? Try fishing, planting crops, tending to livestock, and crafting tools in your new home! The community needs a reliable farmer for their resources; will that be you?

Defeat Hordes of Enemies

Encounter loads of enemy types in various dungeons across Eyndra. Try your hand at close-range sword combat, or master your skills across long distances with a bow and arrow.

Inspiring Landscapes

Elyndra's village is merely the starting point for your journey. Dense forests, snowy peaks, and dewy marshlands await you; within them, local inhabitants are ready to share their stories, problems, and dreams. Build relationships with locals to earn their companionship. Each new ally offers power-ups for farming and combat.

Charming Characters

Face adversity alongside Ariadne and Kaelan, two vagabonds lured to Elyndra by a similar prophetic dream. Watch your companions grow and change as friends, fellow combatants, and valuable farmhands. Everyone has a story to tell... If you're willing to listen.

Your choices shape the fate of Elyndra. Will you answer the call?

short_description: Grow crops, battle monsters, and unearth ancient secrets across diverse biomes as a hired hand in the village of Elyndra. Play as you want--cozy or action-driven--in Elyndra, where farming meets fantasy.
